content.title: 5 EASY HAIRSTYLES FOR THE WEEK ❤️ Monday-Friday New Hair Ideas
content.text: Today’s how-to hair tutorial is 5 quick & simple hairstyles for long and medium hair that will take you through Monday to Friday. Whether you’re heading to work, school, or working from home, these hairstyles are easy, beautiful, and the perfect everyday hairstyles. In this video, I show you: • Monday: Hair down with bouncy curls. Starting the week with a good base (straight or curly) makes the rest of the week so much easier. • Tuesday: A loose, effortless braid inspired by Sofia Richie - casual yet chic, and perfect for any occasion. • Wednesday: A claw clip updo - quick, classic, and the kind of style that lasts all day. • Thursday: A sleek high ponytail - polished and elegant, great for meetings or a night out. • Friday: A sleek braided bun - my favorite “greasy hair hairstyle” that takes you seamlessly from day to night. These looks are ideal for medium to long hair lengths, and they’re all quick enough to do on busy mornings while still looking put-together.
